source_of_truth: Every labeled file was read at the pinned commit; a class is labeled only where a sink fed by request data is actually present in that file. Files whose flaw executes client-side or in a different file than the annotated parameter are labeled with the sink location, mirroring the DVWA fi convention. WebGoat has many more lessons than these labels cover; findings in unlabeled files are reported but not scored.
